evidence_policy.ram_estimate_rule: Do not convert the known dense-byte lower bound into a peak-RAM estimate until Prompt 4 measures selector and model amplification in the monitored pilot.
evidence_policy.pilot_admission_rule: A shape may proceed only as one sequential monitored pilot after static policy validation, explicit projection validation, and live preflight approval. A missing measured multiplier never permits a raised limit.

homecredit.candidate_list_reference: the deterministic 529-feature output of the frozen Home Credit builder, validated against configs/protocols/row_alignment_contract_v1.json
homecredit.dtype_evidence: Raw schema names are frozen, but a complete post-engineering physical-dtype inventory is not frozen; float32 is only a dense lower bound, not a peak estimate.

lendingclub_v2.dtype_evidence: The frozen feature inventory supplies all 675 candidate dtypes; categorical encoding and selector copies remain data-dependent.

stage_projections.why_full_universe_is_required: Both included supervised voters must rank the same complete eligible universe; rf_corr_mrmr emits its top 300 and Boruta emits a full ranking.

operational_requirements: Never hold full DEV and OOT candidate matrices simultaneously.
Release each fold's voter, selection, preprocessing, and model intermediates before advancing.
Validate the projection against the candidate-universe manifest before reading data.
Reject columns=None and any projection containing a forbidden selectable field.
Use CPU execution; no configured run requests GPU resources.
Prompt 4 must measure peak RSS, child RSS, disk use, and wall time and feed the observation back into later preflights.
